item.title: Hawaii Five-O - Force of Waves
item.description: A ruthless businessman is blown up in a boat explosion.

item.title: Matlock - The Photographer
item.description: Matlock goes pro bono to help a troubled young woman accused of murdering her photographer boss.

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Weary Watchdog
item.description: Della asks Mason for $25,000 to help her friend, Janet Brent, who is being blackmailed by an employee of her husband, who has staged compromising photos of her in a motel.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Beaver's Crush
item.description: Beaver has a crush on his teacher, Miss Canfield. When Judy, Whitey and Larry tease him for being a "teacher's pet," Beaver tries to prove them wrong and places a spring snake in her desk. However, Beaver has second thoughts and becomes determined to remove the snake before she finds it.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Beaver's Short Pants
item.description: When June goes on a trip to visit her sister, Peggy, June's Aunt Martha steps in and stays with Ward and the boys. They do their best not to hurt Martha's feelings, but Beaver has the hardest time, when she buys him a suit, knee socks, a cap and short pants and makes him wear the outfit to school.

item.title: Toon In With Me - Pie Day
item.description: Toon In With Me - Pie Day

item.title: Adam-12 - Badge Heavy
item.description: Reed puts his reputation on the line when he decides to file a formal complaint against a fellow officer after witnessing him use excessive force. On patrol, he and Malloy search for suspects in two separate robberies.

item.title: Adam-12 - Training Wheels
item.description: After completing a hazardous driving refresher course, Sgt. MacDonald assigns Malloy and Reed to a nighttime undercover bicycle patrol to test Officer Wells' idea on how to deal with a rash of residential car break-ins. The next day, they pull over a hippie with an obnoxious passenger, and then put their refreshed driving skills to the test when called to a burglary in progress at a new car showroom.

item.title: Dragnet - D.H.O. Missing Persons
item.description: A high school student is missing.

item.title: Dragnet - Homicide - Cigarette Butt
item.description: A murder victim's smoking habits help Friday track down the killer.
